rationale: The mission brief attributes a generator seizing on Day 4 to a long-overdue oil change and recommends including oil in the pre-mission spare parts kit and servicing all generators on arrival. The crew's own report (FLASHLINE-16 DAILY REPORT 08-07-2024, Generator Repair item) says the confirmed cause was a dirty air filter, and the oil was replaced at the same time.
